ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) background with high-frequency distribution of high-intensity (white) linear pixel clusters; estimated 80:20 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity field across both lobes, overlaid with a dense, non-geometric network of high-contrast white linear filaments. No distinct large-scale pigment mottling or solid color banding is present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 50-60 degrees; the notch depth extends approximately 12-15% into the vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with variable pixel amplitudes; distinct notches and jagged indentations are visible on both the left and right lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves sweeping symmetrically outward and upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast circular pixel clusters localized near the distal tips and along the trailing edge margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense and extensive network of multi-directional, overlapping linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 70% of the visible ventral fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable tissue loss and irregular jagged notches along the trailing edges, particularly visible as deep indentations on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and cross-hatched orientation of the linear abrasions across the dark pigmentation provide a unique high-frequency visual texture.
